apps.localizedDescription: SpotiFLAC is a Flutter music app built around installable extensions: an extension supplies the metadata and the audio downloads for one provider, so sources can be added or repaired without an app update. Downloads land in a local library with lyrics, cover art, quality badges and duplicate detection.

versions.localizedDescription:
### New Features

- **onboarding**: Replace the 5.2 tour with a rebrand tour
- **branding**: Use Mornye Ink for the iOS launch screen
- **branding**: Adopt the Mornye logo across the app
- **branding**: Rename app and native backend to Mornye
- **player**: Swipe up on the mini player to open Now Playing
- **playback**: Add normalization pre-amp and track or album gain
- **ui**: Align Material screens with M3 Expressive guidance

### Bug Fixes

- **crash**: Reduce repeated notices and retain diagnostics
- **player**: Prefer embedded art for local files over online covers
- **startup**: Wait for the Activity before backend startup calls
- **library**: Use path index for network scan cache lookups
- **ui**: Align Material screens with the design guide
- **concerts**: Give the Material concert page a Material layout
- **player**: Refresh late duration updates without reopening
- **home**: Match On repeat tracks to their Library entry
- **home**: Show listening sections on the Mornye Home without a feed
- **lyrics**: Ease synced line changes with a spring scroll
- **haptics**: Render music pulses on basic motors and add tuning sliders
- **downloads**: Embed enriched artwork across audio formats
- **artwork**: Read padded ID3 covers and repair cached previews
- **crash**: Exclude system memory kills from crash notices
- **backup**: Reconcile restored iOS paths before publishing history
- **library**: Release network scan memory and cancel active metadata reads
- **android**: Apply renderer compatibility before shared engine creation

### Performance

- **ui**: Improve Material and Mornye player and library smoothness
- **library**: Cache unchanged SMB and WebDAV scan metadata

### Documentation

- **readme**: Remove Related Projects section
- **readme**: Drop heading anchors from feature cards

### Chores

- Update AltStore source to v5.2.0 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])
- **branding**: Drop remaining SpotiFLAC references
- **release**: Bump app to 5.2.1 build 163




**Full Changelog**: [v5.2.0...v5.2.1](https://github.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/compare/v5.2.0...v5.2.1)

---

### Downloads

#### Android
- **arm64**: `Mornye-v5.2.1-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices)
- **arm32**: `Mornye-v5.2.1-arm32.apk` (older devices)
- `*.apk.idsig`: V4 signatures for `adb install --incremental` only; normal installs do not need them

#### iOS
- **iOS**: `Mornye-v5.2.1-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)

### Installation
**Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK
**iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA
